decisions_influenced.decision: Require explicit positivity of 1-eta and 1-alpha and of gamma denominators before clearing denominators or applying rational-inequality tactics.
Flag positivity of 1-eta and, under alpha<1, 1-alpha as explicit proof obligations in the handoff; the source hypotheses provide the strict inequalities needed before clearing divisions.
Used abs_add_le for real absolute-value triangle inequalities in the norm and residual helper proofs.
Established positive denominators from the gamma domain and alpha<1 before the division and geometric-recurrence arguments.
